authorisation: User decisions 2026-11-12: (a) NPIPE/PR4 path excluded; (b) re-fit approved on remaining real-data channels (answer 'Re-fit without CMB/PR4'). This is an unblinded run on those channels; it is NOT the CORE-07 production inference.

operator.command: PYTHONPATH=htt/src:htt:. python3 scripts/r48/refit_hypotheses_no_cmb.py --repo-root <checkout with data files> --out result.json
operator.code_change_enabling_run: TensorJointMultiprobeLikelihood now constructs only enabled probes (test-first); the PR4 CMB carrier/covariance was never loaded in this run
operator.data_files: loaded by the likelihood from the main checkout; per-file hashes of these inputs NOT recorded in this receipt (open item)

channels.excluded: CMB (Planck PR4 carrier and MC100 covariance)

method: maximum-likelihood chi2 minimisation (BFGS in scaled variables, two starts), no prior, psi fixed at likelihood fiducial; theta_K free subsets per hypothesis

results.optimizer: H_loc and H_mix returned 'precision loss' (success=False); two starts agree to ~1e-6 in chi2 for H_loc and to ~2e-5 for H_mix; H_tilt/H_0 trivial

caveats: Fit adequacy is poor: SNe chi2 ~34129 for 490 points and PV ~13749 for 1000 even at best fit (the fixed-psi model with no absolute-magnitude/offset nuisance is mismatched); the BIC ranking among hypotheses is therefore NOT evidence for any hypothesis.
beta_RM does not enter any enabled channel: H_tilt chi2 equals the null exactly (structural non-identification in this data set).
H_mix improves chi2 over H_loc by 3.4 with 8 more parameters; fitted shear sigma5 ~ 1e-3 is 10x the model prior scale and is driven by SNe/PV mismatch, not a shear measurement.

|beta_MO| = 4.9e-3 is about 4x the CMB-dipole speed (1.23e-3); no CMB channel constrains it here; it reflects the count-dipole and SN/PV channels under the fixed-psi model, not an observer velocity estimate.
No posterior sampling, no uncertainties, no calibration against matched nulls.

claims.claim: Maximum-likelihood point estimates for the four hypotheses on six real-data channels exist and are reproducible from the script.
A physical departure from FLRW is detected or preferred.
